title: Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Software Engineering Managers to lead technical teams in the various aspects of the delivery and ongoing support and maintenance of all Linux kernels provided by the Ubuntu Linux distribution. As the Linux kernel itself is now quite broad, so are the technical domains and challenges involved, ranging from integrating support for bleeding‑edge hardware into the latest Ubuntu kernels, to expanding the range of execution environments available to Ubuntu, to the complexities inherent in applying the latest fixes and updates to all of the >100 Ubuntu Linux kernels under active support during our Stable Release Update cycles.

This role would suit either an experienced manager of high‑performing software development teams, or a very proficient technical lead who is excited to take on a management responsibility. You will need to be passionate about Linux and aspire to be an integral part in its distribution to millions of users worldwide.

The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution.
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments.
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms.
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community.
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel.
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel.
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners.

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded.
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers.
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals.
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git.
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded.
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging.
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSPs, and other low‑level system engineering.
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives.
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project.

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Seniority level: Mid‑Senior level

Employment type: Full‑time

Job function: Engineering and Information Technology

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Realizar escavações com a finalidade de localizar a rede de água para executar reparos e novas ligações;
  • Realizar serviços hidráulicos relacionados a vazamentos de água em adutoras, rede, ramal, registro e cavalete;
  • Realizar instalação e substituição de hidrômetros, assim com a padronização de cavalete e ramal;
  • Executar a extensão de rede e a interligação em rede existente, oferecendo serviço de abastecimento de água;
  • Realizar manobras na rede de distribuição de água existente, instalar registro de manobra e descarga da rede;
  • Realizar a aferição da pressão de rede de distribuição de água e medidores;
  • Realizar demais atividades relacionadas a serviços de instalação/reparo e operação de água.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Interesse de atuar na área de Saneamento, levando diariamente dignidade nas porta das pessoas;
  • Será um diferencial ter CNH ativa (categoria B ou acima);
  • Perfil dinâmico, com bom relacionamento interpessoal e trabalho em equipe.
Informações adicionais
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Zenklub - atendimento direcionado à saúde mental;
  • AE Orienta - Aconselhamento Psicológico, Financeiro, Jurídico e social;
  • Gympass - Acesso a academias e demais atividades de bem-estar;
  • Auxilio creche para as mães;
  • Empréstimo consignado em folha;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta! A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Head of Brand, Marketing and Promotion
description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.
Your Profile
  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
Additional Information
  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Marketing and Sales

Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at FIFA Women’s World Cup™ by 2x.

  • Provide on-site support and assistance throughout delivery and go-live phases of project
  • Involvement in responding to RFPs and RFQs
  • Have awareness of product roadmap and the content of future releases
  • Ensure timely completion of internal processes and mandatory training
  • Identify practice development activities and strong involvement in the creation and delivery of these to fellow colleagues
  • Oversee workload distribution across the team
  • Lead knowledge sharing initiatives within the team and the company
  • Act as a reference point to other employees when escalations are required
  • Support with the retention and engagement of employees through on the job mentoring, coaching and performance management
  • Support management team with resource forecasting and planning as well as taking an active role in recruitment of new employees
  • To carry out additional duties as may arise from time to time
  • The Employee is required to follow our clients Information Security Policies (ISP and ISMP) at all times
Microsoft Business Solutions Overview

At our client, your long-term future is every bit as important to them as it is to you. That’s why our clients aim is to give you experiences that will stay with you for a lifetime. Whether it’s great training and development, mobility opportunities or corporate responsibility volunteering activities – you’ll gain a wealth of experiences on which to build a rewarding career. They are a firm that encourages you to be yourself, values your contribution, and inspires you to act as a role model, always focused on doing the right thing for each other, their clients, and their communities.

This sets out all the different ways you’ll be rewarded by our client. Among other things, you can benefit from honest conversations about your career as well as a range of other rewards. In all these ways and more, they have created an environment that can bring out the best in you.

#Bethechange and #makethechange. Join our clients' talented, successful team and make the leap into the future.

For this exciting opportunity they have put together a great package that combines a competitive salary with a bundle of extras including allowances, business travel allowances, certifications to support you in your career growth, private insurance, and medical insurance for you and your family.

title: Vice President, Business Development
description:
The Vice President Business Development individually drives market position and achievement of business outcomes through the Demand and Account Management/Commercial Operations Core Process. This position is a senior level, core sales position within the company responsible for new business/clients as well as managing/leveraging existing accounts. The Vice President Business Development drives results through individual and collective team sales efforts. The position is responsible for leveraging collaboration with internal teams such as marketing, engineering/survey, and product development and technology groups in order to drive service and business outcomes. The Vice President Business Development also contributes to strategic initiatives and planning through an extensive knowledge of market conditions within their assigned specific location or group of locations, country or group of countries, market sector, and/or product(s).

What You Will Do:
  • Execute and drive sales strategies in the assigned area of responsibility and meet or exceed sales and revenue targets with a focus on the marine area.
  • Support the Product & Digital Solution Development, Survey & Certification, Engineering Delivery, and Rule Development Core Processes as needed to achieve organizational business outcomes.
  • Develop and maintain key client relationships with a focus on maintaining current work and expanding new business opportunities and prospect for new clients and business opportunities within your assigned responsibility in marine sector
  • Lead the development of visit plans for assigned clients and area of responsibility, to include organizing client meetings for ABS senior management
  • Execute the Demand and Account Management / Commercial Operations Core Process as appropriate within the assigned area of responsibility
  • Maintains awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate, ensuring peers and teams outside your core responsibility are aware of potential opportunities and needed action
  • Provide strategic insight within the assigned area or responsibility related to future business initiatives, market drivers, and competitor activities for inclusion in business planning
  • Work with organizational teams to develop capture strategies, proposals and pricing as appropriate
  • Work with technical staff and other internal teams as needed to meet customer needs.
  • Attend industry events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
  • Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company’s CRM
  • Forecast sales targets and track activity on accounts to meet these targets
What You Will Need: Education and Experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in business or in an engineering technical field is required
  • MBA or engineering postgraduate degree is preferred
  • Over 20 years of experience in marine sector
  • Typically 7 or more years of experience in the assigned area of responsibility or market sector is required
  • International experience, either as an expatriate or working with international projects and teams, is required
  • Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Demonstrated acumen for sales, business development, and account management with experience in meeting and/or exceeding sales targets preferred
  • Demonstrated proficiency in developing strategic customer relationships.
  • Strong leadership presence and the ability to quickly establish and build credibility and relationships, externally as well as internally to ABS
  • Excellent business judgment, including the ability to assess the reasonableness and likelihood of success of various business scenarios
  • Demonstrated technical acumen related to the product or area of responsibility
  • A self-starter with a demonstrated desire achieve goals and as well as a collaborative personality who effectively works with teams and individuals to achieve organizational business outcomes
Reporting Relationships:

Reports directly to the Senior Vice President

OESD's technical team is responsible for providing high-quality, multi-disciplinary support to GM operating facilities (Refineries, NGLF, and petrochemical plants) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and globally.

Your primary is to provide in-depth process engineering and operations expertise to monitor, optimize, and drive performance improvement programs for Utilities, including both remote and on-site technical advisory support and benchmarking of utilities.

As successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Conduct regular performance reviews of existing Utilities through key performance indicators (KPIs) representing optimum operability, profitability, reliability, and process safety.
  • Develop and present quarterly benchmarking reports with actionable improvement recommendations.
  • Provide hands-on support in implementing performance improvement initiatives, demonstrating measurable results in closing identified gaps from quarterly benchmarking reports.

title: Research Fellow-3
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Research Fellow-3 role at Inside Higher Ed .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.
Core Competencies
  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.
Minimum Requirements
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.

Contexto e Descrição do Projeto

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. O Projeto Light – Exposição Itinerante contempla a realização de uma exposição no Centro Cultural Light, representando a história, o impacto social e o protagonismo da Light ao longo de 120 anos na cidade do Rio de Janeiro, juntamente com o desenvolvimento de atividades imersivas com escolas, com foco em educação ambiental e no consumo consciente, eficiente e seguro de energia elétrica. Em seu segundo ano de vigência, as atividades do projeto foram ampliadas para incluir o apoio ao monitoramento dos espaços de exposição do Centro Cultural Light, contribuindo para a mídia cultural, orientação pública e apoio.

title: Head of Market Analysis
description:
Descrição da empresa

Com mais de 6 mil funcionários em mais de 20 países, a Statkraft é uma empresa norueguesa, com ações pautadas pela ética e transparência. É líder em energia hidrelétrica internacionalmente e a maior geradora de energia renovável da Europa. O grupo produz energia hidrelétrica, energia eólica, energia solar, energia a gás e fornece aquecimento urbano.

No Brasil a empresa tem sua sede localizada na cidade de Florianópolis - SC e também escritórios comerciais em São Paulo - SP (Vila Olímpia) e Rio de Janeiro - RJ (Leblon). Atualmente, controla 26 ativos de geração renovável no Brasil. Em novembro de 2023, a Statkraft assinou a compra da Enerfín, subsidiária renovável da espanhola Elecnor, que inclui nove parques eólicos em operação nos estados do Rio Grande do Sul e Rio Grande do Norte. Dessa forma, a empresa tornou-se uma das maiores geradoras de energia eólica do Brasil, ultrapassando a marca de 2.2 GW de capacidade instalada, entre aquisições, construções e operações no país.

Além disso, a empresa atua na comercialização de energia, a partir dos escritórios comerciais no Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP), com uma carteira de clientes comerciais e industriais de diversos segmentos.

A empresa é pioneira em oferecer energia renovável rastreável com garantia de origem no Brasil, certificando, por meio do I-REC (Certificado Internacional de Energia Renovável), a origem da produção de sua energia, o que garante que a operação é sustentável.

Descrição do emprego

Como Head of Market Analysis, você será responsável por conduzir análises e previsões de preços de energia, bem como pesquisas de mercado, com o objetivo de orientar decisões estratégicas de comercialização de energia e representar a área e reportar análises para clientes internos e externos.

Trabalhando como Head of Market Analysis você irá:

Apoiar ativamente a rentabilidade da empresa por meio do desenvolvimento de análises e previsões de preços de energia, acompanhando variáveis como precipitação, vazão, demanda, intercâmbio de energia entre subsistemas, entre outros, com o objetivo de orientar decisões de compra e venda de energia.

Garantir que as informações inseridas nos modelos de análise de preços estejam corretas, por meio de análise técnica dos pressupostos utilizados nos modelos do CEPEL, consultando relatórios e dados publicados, e realizando processamento de dados quando necessário.

Analisar criticamente os resultados, identificando possíveis desvios e lacunas nos modelos.

Fornecer informações relevantes com qualidade e agilidade sobre fatores que possam afetar variações no preço de mercado, monitorando negociações, notas técnicas e processos da ANEEL e ONS sobre temas regulatórios, através de pesquisas e acesso aos sites institucionais.

Apoiar a melhoria dos resultados de ativos no Brasil por meio do desenvolvimento de análises e previsões de preços de energia, acompanhando variáveis como chuvas, afluências, demanda e intercâmbio de energia entre subsistemas.

Reportar rapidamente e com transparência mudanças regulatórias e informações de preço ao front office e middle office que possam impactar decisões de mercado e avaliações de risco.

Estruturar análises e cenários de preços de forma oportuna, de acordo com a dinâmica dos negócios da Statkraft, garantindo que os recursos e pessoas necessários estejam disponíveis.

Monitorar continuamente informações de mercado e práticas comerciais vigentes para priorizar e direcionar esforços de forma a apoiar soluções comerciais para a empresa.

Qualificações
  • Graduação em Engenharia, Meteorologia, Hidrologia ou Economia;
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças/Projetos/Energia;
  • Sólida experiência na função;
  • Conhecimento nas seguintes áreas:
    • Formação e previsão de preços (PLD);
    • Análise meteorológica e hidrológica para o Brasil;
    • Operação e expansão do sistema elétrico brasileiro;
    • Regulação do setor elétrico brasileiro e Mercado de Energia no Brasil;
    • Análise probabilística e estatística;
    • Programação e automação (Python, VBA, Power BI e Shell Script);
    • Inglês avançado.
Informações Adicionais

Conosco, você desenvolverá uma trajetória profissional com oportunidades incríveis. Isso inclui:

  • Oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional em vários níveis da organização, incluindo LinkedIn Learning, programas e ações de desenvolvimento;
  • A chance de fazer parte de uma organização verdadeiramente global, composta por profissionais competentes, inovadores e responsáveis, de diferentes países e culturas;
  • Uma cultura organizacional que cuida e respeita as pessoas, oferecendo soluções de trabalho flexíveis, princípios de equilíbrio entre vida profissional.
  • Assistência médica e odontológica para você e seus dependentes.
  • Previdência privada, com contrapartida por parte da empresa.
  • Vale alimentação/refeição.
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para filhos até 7 anos.
  • Auxílio para pais e mães com filhos com deficiência.
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, respectivamente 6 meses e 20 dias.
  • PAS – Programa de Apoio Statkraft, serviço profissional com psicólogos, assistentes sociais, advogados e consultores financeiros.

O que é fazer parte da Statkraft?

É contribuir para um planeta mais verde e sustentável. Ser Statkraft é renovar a energia que impulsiona o mundo: uma energia limpa, inspiradora, com ética, integridade e segurança.

Fazer parte da Statkraft é inspirar pessoas a escrever a nossa história, com acolhimento e respeito à diversidade em toda a sua plenitude.

Ser parte da Statkraft é vivenciar os nossos valores, é ser competente, responsável e inovador. É ter uma comunicação aberta e transparente.

Compromisso com a diversidade

A visão da Statkraft é renovar a forma como o mundo é movido. Para navegar essa jornada complexa, precisamos de todas as vozes à mesa. Por isso, trabalhamos ativamente para ser um local de trabalho diverso e inclusivo, e damos boas-vindas a todos os candidatos, independentemente de origem, gênero, idade, orientação sexual, crença religiosa, etnia, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

Nosso processo seletivo é contínuo , o que significa que não há data limite para envio de candidaturas. Enquanto a vaga estiver publicada, seguimos avaliando novos perfis.

Para se candidatar, envie seu currículo através de nossa plataforma. Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você!

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970. A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão. A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação. Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental. Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

  • Identificar as potencialidades e barreiras no aprendizado e na interação social.
  • Planejamento de metas específicas baseadas nas necessidades individuais do paciente. (Plano de Ensino Individualizado).
  • Promover intervenções baseadas em ABA (Análise do Comportamento Aplicada), TCC (Terapia Cognitivo-Comportamental) ou Modelo Denver, visando a redução de comportamentos disruptivos e o aumento de repertório funcional.

  • Realizar a Orientação Parental através do treinamento dos pais para aplicação de estratégias de manejo comportamental no ambiente doméstico.
  • Propiciar o suporte emocional para a família lidar com o diagnóstico e os desafios cotidianos, prevenindo o esgotamento dos cuidadores.
  • Realizar mediação escolar junto aos equipamentos de educação através de orientações à escola para adaptações curriculares e manejo do aluno no ambiente educacional.
  • Elaborar Documentos: redação de relatórios, pareceres técnicos e laudos para fins clínicos, escolares ou judiciais.

title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.

Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.

Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.

“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.

Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.

Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.

“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.

Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Esta tradição, aliada ao seu conhecimento, ousadia e personalidade forte, alçou a Phebo ao topo das marcas de cosméticos mais respeitadas do mercado brasileiro, tornando-se sinônimo de luxo, excelência olfativa e qualidade.

Nossa rica história centenária ajuda a construir um futuro inovador. Estamos presentes em cada produto desenvolvido; em cada loja inaugurada no Brasil e no exterior; em cada embalagem diferenciada e em cada olhar comprometido com o bem-estar das pessoas, com a segurança no local de trabalho e com a preservação do meio ambiente.

Juntas, Granado, Phebo e CARE representam a harmonia entre história e futuro, tradição e renovação, convidando seus consumidores a viverem jornadas únicas de bem-estar e beleza responsável.

title: Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil
description:
Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil

Share

We are delighted to announce that Bruna Carvalho has been appointed to Managing Director, Brazil, effective immediately.

Bruna joined Clarksons in September 2024 and is now firmly establishing Clarksons’ Deep-Sea Tanker desk in Rio de Janeiro. South America is becoming an increasingly significant market. Providing an on-the-ground presence in the region ensures Clarksons is well placed to support clients as the market and opportunity grows. Bruna’s 18-year career at Petrobras has afforded her a wealth of experience and leadership expertise.

“Bruna has demonstrated impact since day one – she fits in well to the Clarksons culture, has contributed tremendously to the relaunch of Clarksons in Rio and has established herself as a strong leader. We are confident that her vision and drive will be instrumental in shaping the next exciting phase of our growth and success in the region, and that she will contribute hugely to the global management team at Clarksons.”

Andi CaseCEO

“My first 9 months at Clarksons have been fantastic. First and foremost, my focus is establishing the tankers presence - nurturing new and existing client relationships and demonstrating the insight and expertise that is available when partnering with Clarksons. I’ve had the opportunity to represent the business at global events, to connect and contribute towards internal networks within Clarksons, and together with the team have shaped our brand-new office space - I feel empowered and very proud to be part of this dynamic and forward-thinking business.”

The Brazil office currently has 20 employees across four service lines – Deep Sea Tankers, Specialised Products, Dry Cargo and Offshore & Renewables. A special mention must go to Jens Behrendt who has laid very strong foundations in the running of the office to date and will continue to head up the region’s Offshore and Renewables desk. Last month, the team hosted a joint celebration with more than 500 clients at the top of Sugar Loaf Mountain, to mark the new office opening in the centre of Rio, providing the space to scale and more than double headcount over the next couple of years.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us! Chief of Staff

The Chief of Staff serves as the Dean’s senior strategic advisor and operational partner, providing executive-level leadership support, institutional coordination, and oversight of school-wide strategic initiatives. This role is responsible for translating the Dean’s vision into actionable priorities, ensuring alignment across academic, administrative, and operational functions, and supporting decision‑making at the highest level of the School.

This position is designed as a future‑state leadership role focused on strategy, governance, and executive coordination. It does not manage day‑to‑day program execution, event planning, or operational delivery functions, which are carried out within academic and administrative units.

The Chief of Staff reports directly to the Dean of the School of Communications.

Supervisory Authority

The Chief of Staff may provide functional and strategic oversight of administrative staff or project teams as assigned by the Dean. Supervisory authority, when delegated, is focused on initiative coordination, performance alignment, and accountability, rather than day‑to‑day task supervision. This role does not supervise academic programs.

Nature and Scope

The Chief of Staff operates at the executive level within the School of Communications and supports the Dean through strategic coordination, leadership advising, and institutional alignment. The role requires independent judgment, discretion, and a high level of professional integrity. The scope of the position is strategic and advisory, rather than programmatic or operational.

Key Responsibilities Executive Strategy & Leadership Support
  • Serve as the Dean’s principal strategic advisor on institutional priorities, organizational effectiveness, and operational planning.
  • Support the development, implementation, and monitoring of school‑wide strategic initiatives and long‑range goals.
  • Prepare executive‑level briefings, analyses, and recommendations to support informed decision‑making.
Institutional Coordination & Governance
  • Coordinate cross‑functional efforts among academic leadership, administrative units, and external stakeholders to ensure alignment with the School’s mission and objectives.
  • Represent the Dean, as appropriate, in senior‑level meetings, working groups, and institutional forums.
  • Monitor progress on key initiatives and elevate risks, dependencies, and decision points to the Dean.
Operational Oversight (Strategic Level)
  • Provide high‑level oversight of administrative and operational workflows to ensure efficiency, accountability, and alignment with institutional standards.
  • Partner with senior administrators to identify opportunities for process improvement and organizational alignment.
  • Support clarity in leadership roles, responsibilities, and decision‑making authority.
Communications & Special Projects
  • Lead or support high‑priority initiatives and special projects at the direction of the Dean.
  • Draft, review, and coordinate executive communications, reports, and institutional correspondence.
  • Ensure consistency and clarity in messaging across leadership initiatives.
Core Competencies
  • Strategic leadership and sound judgment
  • Executive‑level written and verbal communication
  • Organizational effectiveness and process improvement
  • Stakeholder engagement and relationship management
  • Analytical thinking and problem‑solving
  • Project and initiative oversight
  • Professional discretion and integrity
Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred or Minimum 5 years of progressively responsible and relevant work experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in executive‑level administration, strategic planning, or institutional leadership.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in complex, fast‑paced academic environments.

$95,000-$105,000

A L'Oréal está presente em mais de 150 países em cinco continentes. Por mais de um século, L'Oréal dedicou-se exclusivamente a “Criar a beleza que move o mundo”; é agora a líder mundial da indústria, com vendas consolidadas de €29 bilhões. Juntos, resolvemos desafios complexos em grande escala, enquanto continuamos comprometidos em tornar o mundo um lugar mais inclusivo e melhor para todos e para o nosso planeta. Experimente a emoção da agilidade para moldar o futuro da beleza; onde diversidade e propósito se unem e criam um impacto significativo.

Missão:

A missão deste cargo é ser a "voz do consumidor" dentro da L'Oréal, liderando a geração de insights estratégicos que orientem as decisões das divisões de negócio e do time de marketing. O profissional será responsável por transformar dados e tendências em inteligência acionável, mapeando o comportamento do consumidor, jornadas de compra e percepções de marca. O objetivo é garantir que nossas estratégias de inovação, comunicação e produto estejam profundamente conectadas com as necessidades e desejos dos consumidores brasileiros, promovendo uma cultura centrada no cliente e antecipando movimentos de mercado.

  • Analisar tendências de consumo, comportamento social e movimentos da concorrência para identificar oportunidades de negócio;
  • Monitorar de forma contínua o Brand Equity (saúde das marcas) através de estudos de tracking, analisando KPIs de funil e imagem;
  • Analisar a eficácia de campanhas de mídia e o impacto das estratégias de Social e Advocacy na percepção de marca e comportamento do consumidor;
  • Monitorar a performance das inovações lançadas no mercado;
  • Mapear e analisar a jornada do consumidor (omnichannel), identificando gargalos e oportunidades de encantamento;
  • Realizar o cruzamento de fontes de dados distintas (painéis de consumo, social listening, dados internos e pesquisas ad-hoc) para gerar insights holísticos;
  • Facilitar workshops de ideação e sessões de "deep dive" com times de marketing e desenvolvimento de produto;
  • Traduzir dados complexos em narrativas simples e poderosas para influenciar stakeholders de diferentes níveis hierárquicos.
Conhecimentos necessários:
  • Graduação em Marketing, Administração, Publicidade, Ciências Sociais, Estatística ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência anterior em Consumer Insights ou Pesquisa de Mercado;
  • Domínio técnico de metodologias de tracking de Equity de Marca (Brand Health Tracking), incluindo análise de atributos de imagem e força de marca;
  • Domínio de metodologias de pesquisa e painéis (U&A, Testes de Produto/Conceito, Focus Groups, Etnografia, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de mídia e métricas digitais (Social Media, Advocacy e Search Behavior)
  • Inglês avançado;

  • Curiosidade intelectual e paixão pelo universo da beleza e tendências de comportamento;

  • Possibilidades de crescimento, incluindo carreira internacional;
  • Cultura voltada para pessoas, pessoas e pessoas!

description:
Viridien ( is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

Overview

We are looking for passionate geoscientists to join our Interpretation Team at Viridien. In this role, you will contribute directly to Velocity Model Building (VMB) by performing seismic interpretation and providing essential geological support to Processing and VMB teams. From picking horizons to building velocity scenarios, you will work at the intersection of geology, geophysics, and advanced imaging tools, helping to transform complex seismic data into meaningful insights. Your work will play a critical role in delivering high-quality results to our clients and shaping decisions across energy and earth-data projects.

Responsibilities
  • Perform seismic interpretation for VMB, including horizon picking (unconformities, salt horizons, pre-salt).
  • Create local velocity scenarios.
  • Apply imaging tools, workflows, and data QC (attributes, velocities, maps).
  • Integrate geological and geophysical data for deeper insights.
  • Engage directly with clients to present results and understand their perspectives.
About The Team

You will join a diverse group of interpreters, geologists, and geophysicists who collaborate closely with Processing and VMB teams. Together, we tackle complex challenges, share knowledge, and drive innovation in seismic imaging. At Viridien, collaboration is key — you will be encouraged to bring your ideas forward and grow in a supportive environment.

Qualifications
  • Master’s or PhD in Geophysics, Geology, or related field; or equivalent professional experience in the Oil & Gas industry.
  • Solid background in seismic interpretation, exploration geology, stratigraphy, or basin analysis.
  • Strong geophysical knowledge (seismic attributes, AVO, reservoir characterization, quantitative interpretation, well data QC/processing).
  • Ability to integrate data across scales (well, seismic, potential data).
  • Good understanding of seismic imaging and prospect assessment.
  • Experience with Pre-Salt or Brazilian Equatorial Margin is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills in English.
  • Python programming is a plus.

  • Educational Assistance and Language Learning Programs
  • Continuous training via the Learning Hub, with both technical and behavioral courses.
Our Hiring Process

At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience. Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. Only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. We do, however, aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round of interviews and beyond. We are also dedicated to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments to fully participate in the application or interview stages, please don’t hesitate to contact your recruiter directly. We see things differently. title: Managing Director, Programs (Latin American & Caribbean)
description:
Managing Director, Programs (Latin American & Caribbean). Bogota. Posting Date: 02/24/2026. Deadline: 03/05/2026.

Role Title: Managing Director, Programs (Latin American & Caribbean)

Contract Type: Defined Duration – 5 years

Reporting To: Vice President, Programs

Program/Department/Unit Name: Programs

Location: Mexico City, Rio de Janeiro, Bogotá

Team Name: Programs

What is an Opportunity in the OSF context?

Within our programmatic model, OSF allocates resources flexibly and nimbly to an Opportunity, based on the quality of ideas, the strategy and their potential for impact in promoting open societies around the world. Strategies, staffing, and budgets are organized around these powerful, rigorously planned opportunities. Opportunities are multi-year programs with a specific timeframe, budget and measured impact.

Role Purpose

The Managing Director is a generalist manager who oversees the delivery of a portfolio of several geographic and global Opportunities; timebound programs designed to solve complex problems central to our strategic direction. Each of the Opportunities will be led by Opportunity Directors and their teams, to deliver carefully crafted interventions that are planned and judged by the results they deliver. The Managing Director is also responsible for working with other Managing Directors to promote cross collaboration and integration, to bring down silos, and to ensure a healthy organizational culture.

The Managing Directors will be strong managers, able to effectively oversee teams and work closely with the VP of Programs and their peers across the network in building a collaborative culture of both risk-taking and teamwork. They will be supported by an Associate Director, Program Managers, Advocacy Advisors and an Administration Officer, but they themselves will be expected to oversee a portfolio that touches on a mix of different issues within their region and globally.

As a team, the Managing Directors will advise the VP of Programs, to ensure that OSF’s full portfolio is correctly weighted geographically and thematically. Their collective breadth of diversity will also enable the best possible programmatic outcomes. They will coordinate and provide geographic expertise and advice for the development of programmatic work in a specific geography and define OSF’s high‑level approach to the geography and ensures a consistent and informed presence in each region. This role forms part of the programmatic leadership team under the VP of Programs. Whilst they influence, and give input into programmatic direction and strategy, programmatic decision‑making accountability will rest with the Executive Leadership Team. Key decision‑making accountabilities are contained in the key responsibilities section below.

Key Responsibilities
  • Responsible for developing and delivering strong strategic plans with relevant Directors; then subsequent oversight of the implementation and resourcing plans to translate potential ideas into Opportunities for consideration by the Executive Leadership Team and/or the Board.
  • Engagement and employment of OSF strategic capabilities as relevant, (i.e. strategic litigation, advocacy, impact investment) ensuing the most appropriate tactics and tools are used to effect change within and across Opportunities.
  • Ensuring engagement of relevant operations teams in developing and implementing programmatic work.
  • Execute on grant‑making decision‑making, based on the Managing Director approval thresholds, for programmatic workstreams.
  • Build and foster a team culture that emulates OSF values and actively drives team performance.
  • Actively manage a team of high performing Directors, ensuring delivery of critical milestones and exploring potential opportunities.
  • Accountable oversight of a portfolio of multiple Opportunities, ensuring the Director of each Opportunity is accountable for ensuring strategic rigor, for effective management of his/her team, and for delivering on the Opportunity’s goals and working with other Directors to adapt their Opportunities as conditions change.
  • Partner with the other Managing Directors and, as a member of an integrated and mutually interdependent team, ensure that Opportunities are integrated and aligned with the overall OneOSF strategy and vision.
  • Ensure that OSF’s full portfolio of Opportunities is correctly weighted within their respective geography, thematically, by risk threshold, and by level of external partner involvement.
  • Intentionally grow a network of senior leaders and organizations that spans and includes actors beyond the social sector in national and local governments, the multilateral organizations, faith‑based groups, grass‑roots organizations, philanthropy, local experts, academia, think tanks etc. to advance the opportunity. This includes critically developing strong relationships with other funders and bringing them as partners into the Opportunity. Proactively identify emerging risks for the portfolio and Opportunities and work with enterprise risk team to articulate risk mitigation strategies.
  • Lead a Geographic Policy Group for the region that helps define Open Society’s overarching strategic approach to the geography and serves as a space for aligning, aggregating, and advancing work in the geography across components of the opportunity model.
  • Provide geographic expertise and advice for the development of new Opportunities.
  • Monitor and report regularly on the key developments in the region and the progress of Open Society’s work in the region to senior leadership and Communications.
  • Will be engaged with Communications on the development and implementation of an internal and external communications strategy and approach for the relevant geography, considering region‑specific openings and vulnerabilities. Vet all external communications that touch on the geography. As appropriate and when approved, serve as the Open Society spokesperson for the geography including national and local governments, multilateral organizations, philanthropies, and others.
  • Steer key advocacy engagement in/on and about the geography and be cognizant of other advocacy engagement efforts underway by various teams.
  • Coordinate diverse, flexible Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) efforts in partnership with the Strategy and Impact Unit to understand the impact of Open Society’s work across various components of the Opportunity Model in specific geographies.
  • Lead crisis management responses and submit fund requests related to a crisis in the geography. Hold the authority to decline Open Society engagements in the region (grants, staff visits) that may have negative strategic implications. In close cooperation with respective operational units, assess key financial, legal, operational and reputation issues and risks involving the programmatic work in the geography.
  • Liaise closely with the Risk Director and the Risk and Preparedness Committee which has oversight at the organizational level to ensure that our approach to risk is integrated and holistic. Also liaise closely with Global Safety and Security on any security implications of such activity, and with regard to designation of high‑risk countries.
  • Organize senior leadership visits to the region in collaboration with relevant program directors and others.
Key internal relationships

VP Programs; Opportunity Directors, Programs; Program Teams; Special Advisor, Programs; Managing Directors, Network Grants; Advocacy Advisors; Office of the President Executive Advisors, Soros Economic Development Fund; Comms; Justice Initiative; Grants Management; OGC; Risk

Key external relationships

External partners, public and private sector leaders

The ideal candidate
  • Proven senior leadership of social change and system‑change work in civil society, government, multilateral institutions, and/or the private sector that has resulted in positive societal impact.
  • Prior financial (USD $M multi‑million), legal and risk accountability at organizational or large‑scale multi‑geography programmatic level.
  • Network of senior leaders across the social sector in national and local governments, the multilateral organizations, faith‑based groups, grass‑roots organizations, philanthropy, local experts, academia, and think tanks.
  • Effective and proven multi‑country and multi‑nationality people leadership experience; prior experience of leading managers of teams.
  • Leadership of programmatic and/or organizational level change.
  • Proven track record of fostering innovation and creativity at programmatic or organizational level, having established the appropriate risk appetite.
  • Prior experience in multiple sectors and expertise of philanthropic tools such as advocacy and communication, strategic litigation, social impact approaches are advantages.
  • Capability to map and break down complex problems into workable solutions.
  • Understanding and application of a theory of change approach.
  • Strong project management understanding to enable planning for opportunities in terms of time, budget, stakeholder and change management.
  • Ability to draft, edit, and submit proposals that require substantial budget approval.
  • Skilled in building and nurturing partnerships with external stakeholders and able to assess their strengths and weaknesses, as well as deep understanding of political constraints.
  • Ability to build partnerships across sectors and lead a partnership development process.
Languages and Travel
  • Fluency in English and Spanish is essential. Proficiency in Portuguese is an asset.
  • Travel is required. Travel frequency depends on the role requirements.
What We Offer
  • Exceptional opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact; from a generous annual professional development allowance for every employee to onsite training and learning conversations with visiting experts.
  • Excellent benefits and perks to promote well‑being and a healthy work‑life balance, including:
  • Generous time off and flexible work arrangements.
  • Employer‑paid health insurance for individuals and families (no employee contribution required).
  • Exceptional retirement savings plan (non‑contributory for employees) and life insurance.
  • Progressive paid parental leave, reproductive and family planning support, and much more.
  • A commitment to nurturing a diverse and inclusive workplace, so you can bring your whole self to work and make a positive impact.
Description Of The Organization

Open Society Foundations aim to establish vibrant and inclusive democracies where governments are accountable to their citizens. Our operating model organizes grantmaking around specific, time‑limited projects, developed alongside support for established partners, enabling us to respond swiftly to emerging needs. We are committed to promoting human dignity, equality, and rights; reimagining democratic ideals and practice; and advancing equity in governance systems.

Guided by our founder’s values and the belief in the art of the possible, we engage directly with global entities, individuals, and policymakers through grants, advocacy, impact investing, and strategic human rights litigation to drive positive change. At the heart of our mission is a deep commitment to rights, equity, and justice, inspiring every action we take.

Additional Information

Open Society Foundations is committed to building an inclusive workforce that reflects the communities we serve. We actively seek applications from talented individuals across all backgrounds, identities, and life experiences. Each candidate is evaluated solely on their unique qualifications without regard to race, age, sex, religion, ethnic origin, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, or any other legally protected characteristics.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities.

Competitive rates of pay apply.

Open Society Foundations is committed to advancing diversity, equity and inclusion, and to building a diverse staff that reflects the movements, issues and communities that our mission serves. Candidates from all underrepresented backgrounds, identities and communities are encouraged to apply.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants and colleagues with disabilities.

title: Senior Media Operations Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Responsible for the successful implementation of the Media Operations at all stadiums in Brazil for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Media Operations is a very important function in the organisation, as this area is providing the services and conditions for all media to report about the competition to millions of viewers, listeners and readers around the world.

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Media Operations & Services, the Senior Media Operations Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team, and work in close collaboration with Venue Management, Team Services, Competition Management, Media Partnerships, Host Broadcast Operations, Host City Rights Management and other key individuals responsible for planning, delivering and managing Media operations for the more than 2000 national and international media expected to attend the FIFA Women’s World Cup. Success with this project will contribute favourably to the positive outcome of the Women’s Football Strategy .

Key responsibilities

  • Plan and deliver consistent media-dedicated spaces and flows, in all of competition venues in collaboration with other key functional areas.
  • Define strategic implementation of Media Operations & Services in collaboration with the Services manager in each host city based on unique availability of resources.
  • Support the planning and implementation of all corporate media activities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup.
  • Ensure media areas at the competition venues are set up to the highest possible industry standards and are ready to be operational within the agreed timeframe ahead of the start of the tournament.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Senior Media Services Manager to define space requirements for International News Agency representatives at competition venues.
  • Event-time coordination and management of the Venue Media Managers team in the stadiums. Set up regular meetings and workshops with the Venue Media Managers of the stadiums.
  • Plan and train the media volunteers together with the venue managers.
  • Support engagement with local and international media to define requirements and ensure the delivery of operations is set to the highest standards.
  • Implementation of the Camera Loan & repair facilities and any new service.

Your profile

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
  • Higher education qualification in media or sports event management
  • 5+ years’ experience in the sports industry, with an emphasis on media and broadcast operations
  • 5-7 years’ experience in sports project management, preferably in football
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, Spanish and/or French proficiency is a plus
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

A Brunel é uma multinacional holandesa, com mais de 50 anos de atuação e presença em mais de 40 países, especializada em soluções de recrutamento, alocação de especialistas e workforce solutions para setores técnicos e altamente regulados.

Sobre a Empresa

Nosso cliente é uma empresa brasileira do setor farmacêutico, em fase de forte crescimento e consolidação, com atuação focada em inovação, excelência regulatória e expansão estratégica no mercado nacional.

A companhia possui foco em medicamentos injetáveis, com destaque para produtos de alta complexidade, incluindo a tirzepatida, exigindo robustez operacional, rigor regulatório e capacidade de escala produtiva.

Objetivo da Posição

Liderar e estruturar toda a operação da companhia, garantindo eficiência, escalabilidade industrial, conformidade regulatória e integração entre áreas produtivas, logísticas e administrativas, suportando o plano de crescimento e a expansão do portfólio de medicamentos injetáveis.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Liderar as áreas de Operações, Produção, Supply Chain, Logística, Qualidade e Facilities
  • Estruturar e implementar processos operacionais eficientes, escaláveis e aderentes às exigências regulatórias
  • Garantir conformidade com normas do setor farmacêutico, incluindo ANVISA, BPF e GMP
  • Preparar e otimizar a operação para produção e/ou distribuição de medicamentos injetáveis, com destaque para tirzepatida
  • Atuar na melhoria contínua de processos, produtividade e controle de custos
  • Coordenar KPIs operacionais e planos de ação estratégicos
  • Trabalhar em parceria com a diretoria executiva no planejamento estratégico e expansão industrial
  • Liderar equipes multidisciplinares, promovendo cultura de alta performance
  • Apoiar projetos de expansão de capacidade produtiva e lançamento de novos produtos
Requisitos
  • Formação superior obrigatória em Farmácia
  • Experiência sólida em posições executivas de liderança operacional no setor farmacêutico
  • Experiência comprovada com medicamentos injetáveis, preferencialmente tirzepatida
  • Vivência em operações industriais e ambientes regulados
  • Forte conhecimento em supply chain farmacêutica e gestão de qualidade
  • Experiência com auditorias regulatórias
  • Perfil estratégico com forte capacidade de execução

  • Realizar a gestão dos KPIs de performance da rede e conduzir a gestão financeira promocional.
  • Acompanhar o time comercial em reuniões de rede e rotas periodicamente.

Seja bem-vindo à Ambev

ENTRE PARA UM TIME QUE SONHA TÃO GRANDE COMO VOCÊ!

Somos milhares de apaixonados e apaixonadas pelo que fazemos. Temos um orgulho imenso do nosso poder de impacto positivo e reconhecemos que, agindo como donos e donas, cada um de nós desempenha um papel fundamental no sucesso do nosso ecossistema. Somado a isso, todas nossas grandes conquistas tem o sabor da colaboração! Nosso sucesso é compartilhado e acreditamos que por meio da colaboração podemos encantar ainda mais o nossos clientes com as marcas que eles amam hoje, ao mesmo tempo em que podemos atender aos gostos de amanhã.

A Nossa Cultura é focada em construir um ambiente inclusivo e colaborativo, onde as pessoas possam ser o melhor delas mesmas - e nos ajudar a ser a nossa melhor versão! Procuramos gente com paixão, curiosidade e coragem para fazer a diferença aqui.

title: OPERADOR(A) LOGISTICA I
description:
Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações.

Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais.

Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo(B3) e Nova Iorque(NYSE).

Responsabilidades

Responsável em realizar armazenagem e carregamento de produtos acabados no PEPA e L3 com ponte rolante de cabine, obedecendo ao programa de produção e a padrões preestabelecidos, visando atender as necessidades dos clientes.

Pré-requisitos
  • Ensino médio completo
Diferenciais
  • Experiência em armazéns;
  • Experiência com ponte rolante;
  • Experiência com empilhadeira;
  • Experiência em movimentações internas;

Temos como princípio a promoção de um ambiente diverso e inclusivo. Respeitamos e valorizamos a diversidade, por isso todas as pessoas qualificadas serão consideradas para as vagas sem distinção de deficiência, gênero, idade, identidade ou orientação sexual, nacionalidade, raça, religião, ou qualquer outra característica.

title: Gerente de Qualidade, Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento (P&D)
description:
Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Qualidade, Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento (PD) para garantir a excelência e a conformidade dos produtos, atuando como barreira crítica de segurança da produção . Essa posição assegura que somente itens dentro de especificação avancem no processo, com rastreabilidade, evidências e registros completos , liderando a rotina do Controle de Qualidade Laboratorial e apoiando melhorias técnicas e frentes de PD.

Na prática, sua rotina costuma ser assim:

  • Inspeção de recebimento: garantir a execução de testes físico-químicos em matéria-prima e embalagens, com emissão de laudo de aprovação ou laudo de rejeição antes do descarregamento.
  • Liberação de linha e lote: coordenar coletas e análises durante o processo produtivo, assegurando a liberação documentada de cada lote produzido.
  • Bloqueio de não conformidade: identificar desvios em tempo real e executar bloqueio imediato da linha ou do lote, com registro fotográfico e sistêmico, acionando a liderança de operações.
  • Controle de retenção: organizar e catalogar o banco de amostras de retenção diária, garantindo 100% de cobertura por lote e fácil localização para rastreabilidade.
  • Gestão de equipamentos: assegurar rotina de calibração e limpeza dos equipamentos do laboratório, com checklist de aferição registrado no início de cada turno.
  • Gestão da rotina de Qualidade e PD: direcionar prioridades, garantir cumprimento de procedimentos, disciplina de registros/evidências e suporte técnico às necessidades do processo/produto.
  • Documentação e padrões: apoiar manutenção/atualização de POPs, formulários e registros do laboratório, garantindo conformidade e rastreabilidade.
  • Segurança e 5S: reforçar práticas de EPI, manuseio, descarte e organização do laboratório.
Requisitos
  • Formação técnica ou superior em Química ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em Controle de Qualidade Laboratorial (rotina, liberação, rastreabilidade e registros).
  • Perfil de liderança para tomada de decisão e postura firme em bloqueios e tratativas.
Diferenciais
  • Vivência com tratativas de não conformidade e investigação de desvios (ex.: OOS/OOT).
  • Experiência com estruturação de padrões, checklists e rotina de evidências/registros.
  • Atuação com melhorias de processo e suporte técnico a iniciativas de desenvolvimento (PD).
